policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="question" value="@{
      var raw = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? "";
      if (raw.TrimStart().StartsWith("{")) {
        return JObject.Parse(raw)["question"]?.ToString() ?? "";
      }
      return raw.Trim();
    }" />
    
    
    
    
    
    
      v1
    
    
      application/json
    
    
    
      identity
    
    @(new JObject(new JProperty("input", (string)context.Variables["question"]), new JProperty("stream", false)).ToString())
